raw.query: WITH twin AS (SELECT d.run_id, CASE WHEN d.run_id = 'live:twin_fc_p90_cap4' THEN 'forecast' ELSE 'reactive' END AS policy, d.is_current, d.superseded_by, d.window_name, l.p99_ms AS ttft_p99_ms, l.n_requests, i.bound_ms, i.is_violation, c.provisioned_worker_seconds AS replica_seconds, COUNT(r.run_id) AS cost_ratio_rows FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_pool_latency l ON l.run_id = d.run_id AND l.is_current = true AND l.sla_metric = 'ttft' JOIN provenance.v_infraction i ON i.run_id = d.run_id AND i.is_current = true AND i.sla_metric = 'ttft' JOIN provenance.v_pool_cost c ON c.run_id = d.run_id AND c.is_current = true AND c.pool = 'language' LEFT JOIN provenance.v_cost_ratio r ON r.run_id = d.run_id AND r.is_current = true WHERE d.is_current = true AND d.superseded_by IS NULL AND d.run_id IN ('live:twin_fc_p90_cap4','live:twin_re_cap4') GROUP BY d.run_id, d.is_current, d.superseded_by, d.window_name, l.p99_ms, l.n_requests, i.bound_ms, i.is_violation, c.provisioned_worker_seconds), live AS (SELECT policy, ttft_p99_ms, request_count, replica_seconds FROM provenance.v_live_anchor) SELECT t.policy, t.run_id, t.is_current, t.superseded_by, t.window_name, t.bound_ms, t.is_violation AS twin_is_violation, (l.ttft_p99_ms > t.bound_ms) AS live_is_violation, l.ttft_p99_ms AS live_ttft_p99_ms, t.ttft_p99_ms AS twin_ttft_p99_ms, 100.0 * ABS(l.ttft_p99_ms - t.ttft_p99_ms) / t.ttft_p99_ms AS ttft_abs_diff_pct, l.request_count AS live_requests, t.n_requests AS twin_requests, l.replica_seconds AS live_replica_seconds, t.replica_seconds AS twin_replica_seconds, 100.0 * ABS(l.replica_seconds - t.replica_seconds) / t.replica_seconds AS replica_abs_diff_pct, t.cost_ratio_rows FROM twin t JOIN live l USING (policy) ORDER BY t.policy
